question: GOOD PHATS avocado oil manufacturer company
markdown:
Good Phats
is a London-based food brand and startup founded in 2024 by
chef Tom Redwood
. The company specializes in seed-free cooking oils and healthy fats, including Spanish Light Avocado Oil and Spanish Virgin Avocado Oil sourced from Hass and Fuerte avocados
